source_caption_text:
Cardi B KNEW she had a hit when she dropped “Bodak Yellow” 🔥😮‍💨 the rest is history…

Cardi B’s “Bodak Yellow” changed everything for her 🔥💎 Released in 2017, the breakout single turned her unmistakable delivery and confidence into one of the biggest rap moments of the year.

The song spent three weeks at No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100, making Cardi the first female rapper to top the chart without a featured artist since Lauryn Hill’s “Doo Wop (That Thing)” in 1998. Nearly 19 years separated those milestones. 📈

Its success continued long after that initial run. In March 2021, “Bodak Yellow” earned an RIAA Diamond certification, making Cardi the first female rapper to achieve a Diamond-certified single representing at least 10 million units in combined U.S. sales and streaming equivalents. 🏆
